name: despawn_object

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DespawnObject consumes one object ID and passes it to func_00124CA0

notes: func_00124CA0 resolves the encoded object ID and passes the live object to func_00124BC8. That routine moves the object to its exit state, detaches related resources, marks it for removal, and releases it from the active-object manager. ScriptCommand_DespawnObject also clears matching object-list activity fields. The JP corpus contains 450 calls.
